rank_policy.gradient_probe: median stable rank of LoRA A/B gradients on one fixed seeded training batch at capability ceiling
rank_policy.quality_probe: 1 / (1 + cross entropy) on the same fixed seeded training batch after local training
rank_policy.minibatch_note: P1 batch sizes identify capability tiers; P3 training minibatch size is configured separately

domain_policy.implementation: direct import of canonical P2 conservative_domain_factors
domain_policy.update_space: effective LoRA delta-W, including alpha/r; local change from pretraining state when supplied
domain_policy.feature_mean: unweighted arithmetic mean of local updates, as in P2
domain_policy.label_reference: pooled training histogram, formed by summing client counts
domain_policy.privacy_note: training histograms and update signals are exchanged metadata; no leakage protection is claimed

execution: one-process simulation; tree-delivered metadata and peer assembly
quality_definition: post-local-training cross entropy on fixed seeded local training minibatch; 1/(1+loss)

control_transport.execution: single-process transport simulation; read-only payload views share physical memory
control_transport.transport_scope: float64 numerical payloads and int64 source IDs; excludes framing and graph setup
control_transport.privacy_scope: every peer receives all source records; no privacy protection

assembly.memory_scope: transport accumulator plus incoming dense buffer; excludes adapters, SVD and diagnostic workspace
assembly.transport_scope: final reduction only; excludes tree/weight setup and later model dissemination
